assumptions.throughput_source: measured on this host from the 10 pilot training runs and 11 pilot checkpoint evaluations
assumptions.process_setup_basis: SD-1.5 pipeline construction and checkpoint load per invocation; an assumption, not measured in isolation, because the pilot's seconds_per_image already amortises setup over 280 images
assumptions.contingency_basis: one re-run of a failed stage plus bisection overshoot
assumptions.dev_composition: new target 10 prompts x 4 gen seeds = 40 (2.5 pp resolution, the matching quantity); cat 10 x 2 = 20; bird 10 x 2 = 20
assumptions.dumps_evaluated_basis: bisection over 10 saved dumps, assuming suppression is monotone in steps; monotonicity is checked at the evaluated points and a full scan is the fallback
assumptions.final_composition: 7 categories x 10 NEW prompts x 4 gen seeds, newly frozen; the pilot set is exploratory from here on

plans.label: CORE — dog branch only, 2 training seeds. The sandwich branch needs no new compute: it is declared infeasible for matched comparison at L2-SP 25000 from existing evidence (+7.5 pp suppression, below the meaningful region)

wall_time_hours_note.caveat: wall time is NOT GPU-hours; the GPUs are shared without a scheduler and availability is not guaranteed

plans.label: EXTENDED — both branches confirmatory. NOT a drop-in option: it presupposes a sandwich L2-SP coefficient already inside the meaningful region, and the coefficient search that would find one is NOT costed here
